limitations: Source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, Food Price Index, October 2, 2026 release; 12 factual numerical cells from the current CSV, restructured by Decision OS without endorsement.

RIGHTS_RULE=https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/; FAO statistical databases default to CC BY4.0 unless otherwise specified, with attribution and third-party exceptions. Applying this default to the official FFPI CSV is an inference, not a separately named FFPI licence in Annex1. Only factual index cells and our organization are retained; underlying commercial quotations and page full text are not republished.
August and September values belong to same acquired current CSV revision, not contemporaneous vintage data from each month.
FFPI averages five group indices weighted by their average 2014-2016 export shares.
Latest months of Meat Price Index combine observed and projected prices and may materially revise.
Landing prose reported point changes can differ from arithmetic on the currently downloaded revised CSV. Preserve both; do not back-solve previous values.
August and September are compared within one acquired revision, not two contemporaneously archived vintages. No initial public-availability or intraday PIT claim.

The headline and five components overlap; these are six index series, not six independently monitored physical commodities. Percentage change of index levels differs from index-point movement; no company margin effect is inferred.

Current-CSV point changes agree with landing prose for Food and Cereals; Meat, Dairy, Oils and Sugar differ. Both are retained separately; no reverse-engineered historical levels or silent correction.
